Order Order

The petitioner is an accused in connection with  Kesinga P.S. Case No.33 of 2023 corresponding to  C.T. Case No.31/100 of 2023 for the offences  punishable under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n) of the  IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act pending in  the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-  cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Bhawanipatna.
The petitioner had approached the learned Additional  Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge under POCSO  Act, Bhawanipatna in C.T. Case No.31/100 of 2023  praying for grant of bail.
The learned Court below vide  its order dated 08.02.2024 rejected the bail  Page 1 of 4  application of the petitioner.
Being aggrieved, the petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. praying for enlargement on bail.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instruction from the petitioner, submits that, except the present bail application, no other bail application of the petitioner is pending in any other Court relating to the aforesaid F.I.R.
3.

sentences.text: But she did not return home.
The informant searched for her everywhere, but she could not trace her out.
The informant suspected that the present petitioner has kidnapped her daughter.

Hence, the F.I.R.
4.
During the investigation, the statement of the victim was recorded under Section 164 of the Cr. P.C.
She, inter alia, stated that she has been in relationship with the present petitioner.
Since the family members did not agree to their alliance, she fled away with the present petitioner and stayed in a hotel as husband and wife.
Subsequently, the victim was rescued.
5. The charge sheet has been in the present case on 29.12.2023.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that since the petitioner is in relationship with the victim girl, the petitioner is intending to  Page 2 of 4  marry her.
However, the family members are not agreeing this this proposal.
6. Regard being had to the aforementioned facts and the period of custody of the petitioner since 17.11.2023 , I am inclined to admit the petitioner on bail.

7. Hence, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as it would deem just and proper, subject to the following additional conditions:
(1) The petitioner shall appear before the Court, without fail, on every date of hearing; and (2) He shall not influence any of the witnesses related to this case in any manner whatsoever.

In the event the petitioner is found wanting for violation of any of the bail conditions imposed by this Court or the trial Court even on a single occasion, the prosecution is at liberty to move appropriate application before the Court below for cancellation of the concession of bail granted by this Court.
If such application is filed, the trial Court should decide the application on its own merit.
8. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
(S.S. Mishra) Judge Subhasis Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack.
